row: GetPT1st is a grassroots movement to educate the public about the many ways physical therapy can help. We promise to bring the best information possible to help you, whatever your journey. And don’t worry, you won’t have to have a medical dictionary handy or know all the latest research to follow along. This is 100% for you.
